```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, skimr, dplyr, ggplot2, segmented, broom.mixed, brms, tidyvers, rstan, cmdstanr)
```

```{r}
getwd()
```

All data for this project can be found in this kaggle dataset for NBA Data: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/wyattowalsh/basketball/data

```{r}


nba_data <- read.csv("nba_stats/Seasons_Stats.csv")
nba_players <- read.csv("nba_stats/player_data.csv")

```

```{r}
summary(nba_data)
head(nba_data)
```


```{r}
nba_cleaned <- nba_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(PTS) & !is.na(AST) & !is.na(TRB)) %>%
  filter(MP > 0) %>%  # Filter out rows with no minutes played to avoid division by zero
  mutate(
    PTS_per_36 = (PTS / MP) * 36,
    AST_per_36 = (AST / MP) * 36,
    REB_per_36 = (TRB / MP) * 36
  )

```



```{r}
nba_summary <- nba_cleaned %>%
  group_by(Age) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_PTS_per_36 = mean(PTS_per_36, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_AST_per_36 = mean(AST_per_36, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_REB_per_36 = mean(REB_per_36, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(nba_summary, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Avg_PTS_per_36, color = "Points")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Avg_AST_per_36, color = "Assists")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Avg_REB_per_36, color = "Rebounds")) +
  labs(
    title = "NBA Stats per 36 Minutes by Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Per 36 Stats"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Points" = "blue", "Assists" = "red", "Rebounds" = "green"))
```


```{r}
# Add a decade column
nba_cleaned_ext <- nba_cleaned %>%
  mutate(Decade = paste0(substr(Year, 1, 3), "0s"))

# Group by age and decade
nba_decades_summary <- nba_cleaned_ext %>%
  group_by(Age, Decade) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_PTS_per_36 = mean(PTS_per_36, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_AST_per_36 = mean(AST_per_36, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_REB_per_36 = mean(REB_per_36, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Plot trends by decade
ggplot(nba_decades_summary, aes(x = Age, y = Avg_PTS_per_36, color = Decade)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Points per 36 Minutes by Age Across Decades",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Points per 36 Minutes"
  )
```

```{r}
lm_model <- lm(PTS_per_36 ~ Age, data = nba_cleaned_ext)
summary(lm_model)

```

```{r}

# Breakpoint analysis
seg_model <- segmented(lm_model, seg.Z = ~Age)
summary(seg_model)
plot(seg_model)
```

```{r}
# Filter dataset to include only players aged 38 or younger
nba_filtered <- nba_cleaned_ext %>%
  filter(Age <= 38)
```

```{r}
nba_decades_summary_filtered <- nba_filtered %>%
  group_by(Age, Decade) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_PTS_per_36 = mean(PTS_per_36, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_AST_per_36 = mean(AST_per_36, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_REB_per_36 = mean(REB_per_36, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```
```{r}
ggplot(nba_decades_summary_filtered, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Avg_PTS_per_36, color = "Points")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Avg_AST_per_36, color = "Assists")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Avg_REB_per_36, color = "Rebounds")) +
  labs(
    title = "NBA Stats per 36 Minutes by Age (Up to 38 Years)",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Per 36 Stats"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Points" = "blue", "Assists" = "red", "Rebounds" = "green"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(nba_decades_summary_filtered %>% filter(Age <= 38), aes(x = Age, y = Avg_PTS_per_36, color = Decade)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Points per 36 Minutes by Age Across Decades (Up to 38 Years)",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Points per 36 Minutes"
  )
```

```{r}
lm_model_2 <- lm(PTS_per_36 ~ Age, data = nba_filtered %>% filter(Age <= 38))
summary(lm_model_2)
```

##Non-Linear approach

```{r}
lm_quadratic <- lm(PTS_per_36 ~ Age + I(Age^2), data = nba_filtered %>% filter(Age <= 38))
summary(lm_quadratic)
```

```{r}
coeffs <- coef(lm_quadratic)
peak_age <- -coeffs["Age"] / (2 * coeffs["I(Age^2)"])
print(peak_age)
```





```{r}
ggplot(nba_filtered %>% filter(Age <= 38), aes(x = Age, y = PTS_per_36)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Nonlinear Effect of Age on PTS_per_36", x = "Age", y = "PTS per 36 Minutes")

```

```{r}
nba_filtered_erasplit <- nba_filtered %>%
  mutate(Era = ifelse(Year < 2000, "Pre-2000", "Post-2000"))
```

```{r}
# Pre-2000 model
pre_2000_model <- lm(PTS_per_36 ~ Age + I(Age^2), data = nba_filtered_erasplit %>% filter(Era == "Pre-2000"))

# Post-2000 model
post_2000_model <- lm(PTS_per_36 ~ Age + I(Age^2), data = nba_filtered_erasplit %>% filter(Era == "Post-2000"))

summary(pre_2000_model)
summary(post_2000_model)

```

```{r}
# Calculate peak age for Pre-2000
pre_2000_coeffs <- coef(pre_2000_model)
pre_2000_peak_age <- -pre_2000_coeffs["Age"] / (2 * pre_2000_coeffs["I(Age^2)"])

# Calculate peak age for Post-2000
post_2000_coeffs <- coef(post_2000_model)
post_2000_peak_age <- -post_2000_coeffs["Age"] / (2 * post_2000_coeffs["I(Age^2)"])

print(pre_2000_peak_age)
print(post_2000_peak_age)
```



```{r}
combined_model <- lm(PTS_per_36 ~ Age * Era + I(Age^2) * Era, data = nba_filtered_erasplit)
summary(combined_model)
```

```{r}
nba_hierarchical <- nba_filtered %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  filter(n() > 5) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
hierarchical_model <- brm(
  PTS_per_36 ~ Age + I(Age^2) + (1 + Age + I(Age^2) | Player),
  data = nba_hierarchical,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 2000
)
```

Technical issues regarding the Stan program made it so this code currently doesn't run fully, but too properly asses the research question, this would a better procedure than the current methods employed.

```{r}
predictions <- nba_hierarchical %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  mutate(predicted_PTS = fitted(hierarchical_model)[, "Estimate"])

# Plot player-specific trajectories
ggplot(predictions, aes(x = Age, y = predicted_PTS, color = Player)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Player-Specific Trajectories (Predicted PTS per 36 Minutes)",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted PTS per 36 Minutes"
  )

plot(hierarchical_model, ask = FALSE)


```

```{r}
# Convergence diagnostics
plot(hierarchical_model, ask = FALSE)

# Posterior predictive checks
pp_check(hierarchical_model)
```
